concentration_all.note: Raw noise-corrected estimates, including negatives. A ratio may fall outside [0,1]; nonpositive denominators have no meaningful concentration estimate.

concentration_open_union.note: Raw noise-corrected estimates, including negatives. A ratio may fall outside [0,1]; nonpositive denominators have no meaningful concentration estimate.

notes: Sample collapse is finite-sample duplicate evidence, not proof of zero population sensitivity.
Proposal sensitivity contrast is not logprob typicality; its sign may be negative.
Openness/floor/ceiling are empirical strata. Four Sol failures do not establish impossibility.
